Hajun: 1 bread or 4 cookies

y-m-72-03.title: If income increase, money wey you carry go house go reduce?
y-m-72-03.topic: Tax rates by bracket and take-home income (progressive rule)
y-m-72-03.goal: Apply correctly the point say wen you pass bracket border, new tax rate apply only to amount above border, no be the whole income; make examples yourself where take-home income increase even though average tax rate go up.
y-m-72-03.material:
The following na imaginary income tax rule for this task (e no be real tax law). Annual income (in 만원) dey split into brackets, and each bracket rate apply only to amount wey enter that bracket.
- Part up to 4,000만원: 10%
- Part above 4,000만원 and up to 8,000만원: 20%
- Part above 8,000만원: 30%
Tax na total taxes on those three parts, and take-home income na income minus tax. Seoyun solve am and talk, 'Once you pass 4,000만원 rate become 20%, so you actually lose.'
